name: Party Quiz
description: Multiplayer trivia board: players join from their phones by scanning the Deck, the Deck shows questions, countdown, reveal and podium
config_help: Players scan the QR code shown in the lobby with their phone camera. The first player to join hosts the game and starts it from their phone. Questions are downloaded from Braiins Forge and cached on the Deck, so a game also works without internet once a pack has been downloaded.

category_pack.name: Category pack
category_pack.description: Which question pack the game draws from

question_count.name: Questions per game
question_count.description: How many questions one game has

answer_time.name: Answer time
answer_time.description: Seconds players have to answer each question

show_player_names.name: Show player names on Deck
show_player_names.description: Show player names next to avatars on the Deck; off shows colours only

sounds.name: Sounds
sounds.description: Play countdown ticks, reveal chimes and the podium fanfare
